app.name: Istiqamah
app.tagline: Small, steady steps in your deen — together.
app.description: A gentle daily companion for prayer, Quran, adhkar and fasting, with small accountability circles of friends.

common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

landing.eyebrow: A gentle companion for your deen
landing.headline: Steadfast, one day at a time.
landing.body: Track your prayers, Quran, adhkar and fasting with kindness, and walk the path with a few close friends. No rankings and no shame. Just begin again, every day.
landing.trust: Free · Private by default · Works offline
landing.previewNudge: Thinking of you. Let’s pray together.
landing.manifesto: Missed a day? Begin again. Istiqamah never shames, ranks or compares. It simply helps you return, one small deed at a time.
landing.trackerTitle: A daily tracker that feels light
landing.trackerBody: The five prayers, Quran by pages or minutes, morning and evening adhkar, fasting, and habits of your own. One tap each.
landing.timesBody: Calculated for your location with the method your community follows.
landing.offlineBody: Check in on the train or in the masjid. It syncs when you’re back.
landing.circlesBody: Invite a few friends with a link. You choose, habit by habit, what they can see. No leaderboards, ever.
landing.khatmBody: Start a circle khatm and let each friend claim a juz.
landing.privacyBody: Minimal data, no ads, no trackers. Export or delete everything anytime.
landing.step1Body: A link to your email or Continue with Google. No passwords to remember.
landing.step2Body: Pick a few habits and set your location for prayer times. Start small.
landing.step3Body: Check in each day, invite a friend or two, and send each other a dua.
landing.trustBody: Quran, hadith and dua text is never written by AI. It comes from established sources, and every item shows its reference.
landing.finalBody: It takes a minute to set up. Your first check-in is the hardest, and the sweetest.
landing.point1Body: The five prayers, Quran, morning and evening adhkar, fasting and your own habits.
landing.point2Body: Encourage friends privately. You choose what they can see.
landing.point3Body: Minimal data, no ads, no public leaderboards. Export or delete anytime.
landing.deleted: Your account and all of your data have been deleted. May Allah make it easy for you.

auth.signInBody: Sign in with a link sent to your email, or continue with Google. New here? The same steps create your account.
auth.checkEmailBody: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. It expires in 15 minutes. You can close this tab.
auth.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.

onboarding.title: Let's set things up
onboarding.nameHelp: Only people in your circles will see this name.
onboarding.timezoneHelp: Used so your day starts and ends at the right time.
onboarding.locationHelp: We store an approximate location (about 1 km) only to calculate prayer times. You can change or clear it anytime.
onboarding.locationDenied: We couldn't access your location. You can type your city instead.
onboarding.methodHelp: Different organisations use different conventions. If unsure, ask your local masjid which they follow.
onboarding.habitsTitle: What would you like to track?
onboarding.habitsHelp: Start small. You can add, remove or adjust habits anytime.

habits.prayersHelp: Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib and Isha
habits.fastingHelp: Including Mondays, Thursdays and the white days

today.allDone: Alhamdulillah — everything is done for today.
today.noneYet: A new day. Start with whatever is closest.
today.someDone: Steady steps. Keep going, one at a time.
today.noLocation: Add your location to see prayer times.
today.timesUnavailable: Prayer times are unavailable right now.

sync.offline: Offline — saved on this device, will sync when you reconnect.
sync.unauthorized: Please sign in again to sync your changes.

settings.title: Settings
settings.exportBody: Download everything we store about you as a JSON file.
settings.deleteBody: Permanently deletes your profile, habits, history, circle memberships and the circles you created. This cannot be undone.

scholar.note: Istiqamah is a tool for consistency, not a source of rulings. It does not issue fatwas. For questions of fiqh, please consult a qualified scholar or your local imam.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.body: No connection right now. Anything you've opened recently is still available.

week.title: This week
week.beginAgain: Missed days are behind you. Every day is a chance to begin again.
week.editHint: Tap a day to correct it (up to 7 days back).

manage.title: Manage habits
manage.intro: Track what helps you right now. Stopping a habit keeps its history.
manage.namePlaceholder: e.g. Give sadaqah, Call my parents
manage.removeConfirm: Remove "{name}" and its history? This cannot be undone.
manage.shareHelp: Circle members will see whether you completed it each day. Nothing else.

circles.title: Circles
circles.intro: Small groups of friends who encourage each other. Private by default: members only see the habits you choose to share.
circles.empty: You’re not in a circle yet. Start one with a few close friends, or join with an invite code.
circles.descPlaceholder: e.g. Keeping each other steady this Ramadan…
circles.errorInvalidCode: That code doesn’t match a circle. Check it with your friend and try again.
circles.errorFull: This circle is full. Ask the owner to make room.
circles.inboxEmpty: When a friend sends you encouragement, it’ll appear here.
circles.inviteBody: Share this link or code. Anyone with it can join while there’s room.
circles.newCodeConfirm: Make a new invite code? The old link will stop working.
circles.youShareNothing: You aren’t sharing any habits yet.
circles.sharingNote: Circles never rank anyone. Each person decides what’s visible.
circles.duaUnavailable: Duas can’t be loaded right now. Kind words still work.
circles.limit: You’ve sent plenty today. Try again tomorrow.
circles.leaveConfirm: Leave this circle? You can rejoin with an invite code.
circles.deleteConfirm: Delete this circle for everyone? This cannot be undone.
circles.joinPageBody: Join {name}, a circle of {count} on Istiqamah.
circles.invalidInvite: This invite link isn’t valid any more. Ask your friend for a new one.

khatm.title: Circle khatm
khatm.intro: Read the whole Quran together. Each person claims a juz and marks it when done.

nudges.thinking_of_you: Thinking of you today. You’ve got this.
nudges.quran_together: Let’s read a little Quran today.
nudges.begin_again: Every day is a fresh start. Let’s begin again together.
nudges.made_dua: I made dua for you today.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.intro: Optional notifications when each prayer time begins, and gentle nudges for morning and evening adhkar.
reminders.on: Reminders are on for this device.
reminders.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser settings, then try again.
reminders.unsupported: This browser can’t receive reminders. On iPhone, add Istiqamah to your Home Screen first, then open it from there.
reminders.needsLocation: Reminders need your location to know prayer times.
reminders.devOnly: Reminders are available in the installed app (production build).
